# Errors the OpenAPI breaking-change check lets through. openapi-validator.yml gives this file
# to its oasdiff step as `err-ignore`; oasdiff reads it for errors only, so warnings stay.
#
# oasdiff skips an error when one line names its METHOD /path and holds its text word for word,
# value, property path and response status included. So each line lets one change through, and
# the same value in another operation, property or status is still an error. To let another
# through, copy its error from the check's log, with a comment that says why.
#
# answerHidden.reason says why an answer in a shared chat is hidden from its reader. Each value
# below is an intended, additive class of reason (HiddenAnswer in the spec says what each means):
# no_access, personal, agent, deleted and stopped. A client must accept a reason it does not know
# and show the answer as hidden. The archive listing gets the same values as warnings, not errors,
# so it is not listed here.

# no_access
POST /agents/{agentKey}/conversations added the new `no_access` enum value to the `conversation/messages/items/answerHidden/reason` response property for the response status `201`
DELETE /agents/{agentKey}/conversations/{conversationId} added the new `no_access` enum value to the `conversation/anyOf[#/components/schemas/StoredAgentConversation]/messages/items/answerHidden/reason` response property for the response status `200`
GET /agents/{agentKey}/conversations/{conversationId} added the new `no_access` enum value to the `conversation/messages/items/answerHidden/reason` response property for the response status `200`
POST /agents/{agentKey}/conversations/{conversationId}/messages added the new `no_access` enum value to the `conversation/messages/items/answerHidden/reason` response property for the response status `200`
PATCH /agents/{agentKey}/conversations/{conversationId}/title added the new `no_access` enum value to the `conversation/messages/items/answerHidden/reason` response property for the response status `200`
POST /conversations/create added the new `no_access` enum value to the `conversation/messages/items/answerHidden/reason` response property for the response status `201`
POST /conversations/{conversationId}/messages added the new `no_access` enum value to the `conversation/messages/items/answerHidden/reason` response property for the response status `200`
POST /conversations/internal/create added the new `no_access` enum value to the `conversation/messages/items/answerHidden/reason` response property for the response status `201`
POST /conversations/internal/{conversationId}/messages added the new `no_access` enum value to the `conversation/messages/items/answerHidden/reason` response property for the response status `200`
